jobs.description:
Are you the kind of person who can spot a perfectly poured beer faster than a bad joke? 

Do you love a bustling hospitality environment, fun coworkers, and a bar that’s never boring? 

Then we’re sure to have your next challenge waiting for you.
 

Bier Central Brussels is looking for a full-time bartender to join the team.
 

What will you be doing?
 

- Pouring beer as if it were an art form. 

- Welcome guests with a smile. 

- Take orders and serve drinks. 

- Keep the bar clean and organized. 

- Help create the lively atmosphere that Bier Central is known for.

- Ideally, you already have some serious experience working behind a bar.

- You live in Brussels.

- You don’t rely on public transportation. We close between midnight and 1:00 a.m., so being able to get home on your own is important.

- Working on weekends is a given for you.

- You understand and speak French at a basic level.

- You speak and understand English. Other languages? Those are just bonus points.

jobs.occupation: COMPLIANCE DATA AND REPORTING OFFICER, Junior role M/W/X
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Compliance Data and Reporting Officer to support the Compliance function in strengthening the quality, reliability, and efficiency of its data, reporting, and information management processes. This is a junior role designed for a rigorous and analytical profile who is comfortable working with data, coordinating with multiple stakeholders, and contributing to the continuous improvement of compliance processes in a fast-growing fintech environment. 

In this role, you will help ensure the timely preparation, coordination, and delivery of compliance reports, including periodic and ad hoc data regulatory reporting. You will maintain reporting calendars, monitor deadlines, support the collection and validation of relevant data, and contribute to the production of accurate and structured reporting outputs for internal stakeholders and, where applicable, regulators. 

The position will contribute to broader compliance management initiatives aimed at improving the use of tools and technology within the Compliance function, including reporting workflows, JIRA-based tracking, data visualisation, automation, and AI-supported information processing. Through these activities, you will play an important role in helping Compliance teams make better use of data, reduce manual effort, and enhance the reliability of management information. 

The position reports functionally and administratively to the Global Head of Regulatory Affairs. 
 
What you will do  

• Maintain reporting calendars and ensure timely delivery of all compliance reports 
• Work closely with product and data team for regulatory periodic and ad hoc reporting  
• Support enhancements to digital onboarding data capture and KYC process automation 
• Support data quality initiatives to ensure accuracy and completeness of compliance reporting 
• Identify opportunities for data process optimization and automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort 
• Provide data insights and analytical support to Compliance Officers and first-line teams 
• Identify practical obstacles to data quality and reporting processes 
• Escalate data-related issues and improvement needs to appropriate owners 
• Support in transmitting reports to regulators of some designated countries 
• Support any compliance management initiatives aiming at enhancing compliance data processing and visualiztion (e.g. JIRA) and information processing (AI) 

What do you bring? 
• You hold a master's degree or equivalent in business law, banking and financial law, financial economics, or a related field 
• You have 1+ year of experience in Fintech or Paytech environment 
• You are rigorous, well-organised, and comfortable working with data and producing structured reports 
• You have strong analytical skills and are able to synthesise complex information into actionable insights 
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint and ease of learning other tool capabilities (JIRA, AI) 
• 
You are fluent in English, French is a plus 

 
 
What do we offer? 

• Diverse missions and projects in an innovative and growing Fintech company; 
• A meaningful role within the second line of defence, with real visibility and impact; 
• A professional, international team with a collaborative and flat hierarchy; 
• A dynamic and supportive work environment in Brussels.

The role ensures accurate data management, timely processing of purchase orders, and effective coordination between suppliers, warehouse, and internal teams to maintain efficient material flow and stock availability.

Client Details

The company operates in the pharmaceutical sector.

Description

As a Planning and Procurement Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Manage purchase orders and maintain accurate planning, purchasing, and ERP data.
• Coordinate with suppliers on orders, deliveries, documentation, and issue resolution.
• Monitor inventory levels and support inbound logistics and delivery tracking.
• Prepare reports, maintain records, and support KPI monitoring and data accuracy.
• Collaborate with planning, warehouse, logistics, customer service, and finance teams to support daily supply chain operations and follow up on action items.

A successful Planning and Procurement Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• 1-2 years of experience in an administrative, logistics, purchasing, or supply chain support role.
• Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP, JD Edwards, or similar) and good command of Microsoft Excel.
• Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, and administrative organization.
• Effective communication skills with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Ability to prioritize tasks, work in a fast-paced environment, and collaborate across teams.
• Proactive, reliable, and team-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in both French and English (written and spoken).

Are you passionate about technology and eager to kick-start your career in IT support? We are looking for a Junior IT Support Engineer to join a dynamic international environment in the heart of Brussels.

A leading international mobility group is looking for a Social Relations Manager to play a strategic role in shaping and professionalising employee relations across Belgium.

With more than 3,000 employees, a nationwide presence and strong growth ambitions, the company operates in the public and private passenger transportation sector, collaborating with major mobility partners throughout Belgium. Backed by an international group active across multiple continents, the organisation combines local entrepreneurship with the strength of a global market leader.

As part of their continued expansion, they are seeking an experienced social relations expert to strengthen social dialogue, ensure compliance with Belgian labour legislation and support long-term organisational growth.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the HR Director, you will be responsible for managing and coordinating social relations at a national level. Acting as a key partner to HR, Operations and employee representative bodies, you will ensure a consistent and compliant approach to employee relations across multiple sites in Belgium.

Your main Responsibilities include:

• Coordinating Central and Local Works Councils
• Supporting management teams and HR stakeholders in social dialogue matters
• Leading and coordinating Belgian Social Elections
• Managing collective bargaining agreements and work regulations
• Ensuring compliance with Belgian labour legislation
• Coordinating social inspections and audit preparation
• Developing and professionalising social consultation processes and governance
• Acting as the internal expert for complex employee relations topics
• Supporting constructive relationships with trade unions and social partners

Location: Diegem, with regular travel across Belgian sites.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law or Human Ressources
• Minimum 7 years of experience in HR, Employee Relations or HR Business Partner positions within operational environments
• Strong expertise in Belgian social legislation
• Proven experience with:
• Works Councils
• Social Elections
• Trade Union Relations
• Social Inspections
• Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBA)
• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
• Diplomatic, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach
• Strong organisational and project management skills
• Fluent in Dutch and French
• English is considered an asset

Reporting directly to the Product Development Leader, you will be responsible for the development and optimization of new products within the RV business line. This includes product categories such as awnings, bike racks, steps, and soft goods (tents and panels).

 
• 
You lead the development of new products from concept through to industrialization, ensuring alignment with both external requirements and internal quality standards.

 
• 
You identify opportunities for product improvements, focusing on functionality, performance, and quality.

 
• 
You work in accordance with the Project System, following a structured stage-gate process.

You act as the technical point of contact for suppliers, refining designs and ensuring manufacturability.

• 
You have strong proficiency in 3D CAD; experience with SolidWorks is a strong advantage.

 
• 
You take full responsibility for your projects, combining an entrepreneurial mindset with structured execution.

 
• 
You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
You combine creative, conceptual thinking with a strong analytical approach.

 
• 
You naturally align with and represent the brand identity and active lifestyle values.

As part of the Product Development Compliance team, you ensure that both new and existing products are tested, verified, and approved in accordance with the strict requirements. You define and maintain test plans, evaluate test results, and remain actively involved in technical product improvements throughout the development process. In this role, you safeguard and confirm the technical compliance of all products within the RV business line, including awnings, bike racks, steps, and soft goods (tents and panels).

Role and tasks

 
• 
You establish and maintain test procedures, ensuring full alignment with the Test Code.

 
• 
You develop and/or execute the required tests to demonstrate safety and conformity of components and finished products.

 
• 
You perform testing on prototypes and existing products with the aim of improving quality, and provide technical input for product improvements based on test outcomes.

 
• 
You define and manage test plans within product development projects.

 
• 
You monitor incoming test requests and coordinate planning accordingly.

 
• 
You own the RV test center and drive continuous improvements to ensure compliance with defined procedures and testing standards. You also define and justify required investments to the Product Development Leader.

 
• 
You act as the main point of contact for the Test Center and build strong working relationships with external laboratories and knowledge centers.

 
• 
You plan and coordinate testing activities both within the Test Center and with external partners.

 
• 
You provide technical support to internal stakeholders such as sales, product management, production, and process engineering.

 
• 
You manage and coordinate projects related to the responsibilities above.

 
• 
You ensure all test reports are properly stored and accessible within the PLM system.

 
• 
You stay up to date with relevant standards and ensure test methods remain current and compliant.

 
• 
You are an active member of the compliance team.

 
• 
You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in (Electro-)mechanics or a related technical field.

 
• 
You have strong technical expertise and are a natural problem solver.

 
• 
You are creative in designing and developing new test methods.

 
• 
You are hands-on and take full ownership of your work.

 
• 
You have strong spatial awareness and are comfortable working with technical drawings.

 
• 
You have a basic understanding of electronics (e.g. motors, control units, etc.).

 
• 
You are an effective communicator, able to collaborate across teams.

 
• 
You have strong language skills: fluent Dutch, good English, and basic knowledge of French and German.

 
• 
You enjoy hands-on testing, including dismantling and destructively testing products.

 
• 
You take full responsibility for your projects, combining entrepreneurial drive with a structured approach.

 
• 
You work in a precise, organized, and methodical way.

 
• 
You are proficient in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
You are a creative and conceptual thinker with a strong analytical mindset.

 
• 
Knowledge of SolidWorks is considered an advantage.

 
• 
Experience with simulation software (FEM) is a plus.

 
• 
You naturally embody and represent the brand identity and active lifestyle values.

Kwery is looking for a Software Architect (.NET) for an innovative SaaS scale-up. This company develops advanced AI-driven software.

You'll join an ambitious, fast-growing international scale-up where innovation, autonomy and short decision-making lines are at the heart of the company culture. Together with a highly experienced team of engineers, you'll contribute to an international SaaS platform that enables leading organizations to adopt AI in a safe, compliant and responsible way.

Are you eager to shape the technical vision of an innovative AI platform and leave your mark on the future of a rapidly growing company? Then this could be the opportunity you're looking for.
What will you do?

• Lead the technical design, development and maintenance of a scalable and secure SaaS platform, making future-proof architectural decisions.

• Develop new features end-to-end, perform code reviews and continuously improve the platform's performance, reliability and maintainability.

• Contribute to the technical roadmap, evaluate architectural approaches and leverage innovative technologies, including AI tools, to continuously improve both the software and development processes.

What are they looking for?

• You bring more than 10 years of experience in software engineering and have built up strong expertise in software architecture. You live in Belgium and are legally authorized to work here.

• You have strong expertise in .NET and C#, combined with experience in fornt-end development. You look beyond the code itself and know how to apply the right architectural principles and design patterns based on the platform's needs.

• You take initiative, enjoy solving challenges and feel at home in an entrepreneurial scale-up environment. You have excellent communication skills in English.

Job Description
 

In this role, you will play a central part in processing and managing customer orders within an international environment. You will ensure smooth administrative handling while monitoring quality, timelines, and communication throughout the entire order lifecycle.
 

Key Responsibilities
 

 
• Coordinate and manage the complete order process from request to delivery
 
• Process sales orders and quotations with a strong focus on accuracy
 
• Liaise with internal departments regarding product availability, deliveries, and invoicing
 
• Prepare and manage export documentation for international shipments
 
• Handle returns and follow up on customer complaints
 
• Keep customers informed about order status and deliveries through reporting tools
 
• Maintain proactive communication with stakeholders, including customers, Sales, Supply Chain, and Finance teams
 
• Prepare and distribute reports on order status, deliveries, and critical issues
 
• Identify potential bottlenecks within processes and contribute to improvement initiatives
 
• Participate in internal meetings and collaborate with various departments 

Requirements
 

 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience
 
• 1 to 3 years of experience in customer service, administration, or order management
 
• Experience in an international environment is a strong asset
 
• Experience in the shipping industry
 
• Experience with shipping documents (Sea Waybill, Bill of Lading,...)
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Teams, Power BI)
 
• Knowledge of Incoterms and international payment terms is considered an advantage
 
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
 
• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and accuracy
 
• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset
 
• Customer-focused with excellent communication skills
 
• Team player who thrives in an open and collaborative working environment
 
• Able to work independently with a hands-on approach
 
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Italian, Spanish, or any other additional language is a plus.
